ideas_declared.rationale: note p.6 / contents item 1b, textbook bullish RSI divergence: price undercuts the last confirmed swing low (lookback=5) while RSI sits above where it read at that swing low. The exact hypothesis the 2026-08-11 study recorded as untestable (REPORT.md claim #7).
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: the 5-bar forward hit rate does not exceed the same-bars baseline, OR does not exceed the new_low_alone / rsi_above_swing_alone control arms' edges
ideas_declared.source: note p.6, contents item 1b, bullish RSI divergence

ideas_declared.rationale: note p.6 verbatim: 'Divergences btw price & MACD => signal of possible trend change' -- the note's own claim names MACD specifically. Price undercuts the last confirmed swing low while the MACD line sits above where it read at that swing low.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: the 5-bar forward hit rate does not exceed the same-bars baseline, OR does not exceed the new_low_alone / macd_above_swing_alone control arms' edges
ideas_declared.source: note p.6, verbatim MACD divergence claim

ideas_declared.rationale: Bearish mirror of bullish_rsi_divergence: price exceeds the last confirmed swing high while RSI sits below where it read at that swing high. Tested as a direction=down hypothesis on forward returns -- this long-only engine cannot short it, so no strategy backtest is run for this idea; see the report.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: forward returns following the signal are not lower than the same-bars baseline (a positive or zero edge rejects the hypothesis as written)
ideas_declared.source: note p.6, bearish mirror of the RSI divergence claim

ideas_declared.rationale: Bearish mirror of bullish_macd_divergence. Tested as a direction=down hypothesis on forward returns only -- not tradeable through this long-only engine.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: forward returns following the signal are not lower than the same-bars baseline
ideas_declared.source: note p.6, bearish mirror of the MACD divergence claim

ideas_declared.rationale: Control 1/3: the price half of both bullish conjunctions, with the oscillator condition removed entirely. Price simply undercuts its last confirmed swing low. If this performs as well as bullish_rsi_divergence / bullish_macd_divergence, divergence adds nothing -- the whole concept is a story told about a new low.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: bullish_rsi_divergence's and bullish_macd_divergence's edges do not exceed this control's edge, on the same symbol

ideas_declared.rationale: Control 2/3: the RSI half of bullish_rsi_divergence, with the price condition (price must be making a new low) removed entirely.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: bullish_rsi_divergence's edge does not exceed this control's edge, on the same symbol

ideas_declared.rationale: Control 3/3, symmetric to rsi_above_swing_alone: the MACD half of bullish_macd_divergence, with the price condition removed entirely.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: bullish_macd_divergence's edge does not exceed this control's edge, on the same symbol

ideas_declared.rationale: Lookback-sensitivity pair (brief-mandated): identical rule to bullish_rsi_divergence, lookback=10 instead of 5 -- fewer, more strongly confirmed pivots, published 5 bars later. Same horizon, same mechanics, so any change in verdict is attributable to the lookback parameter alone.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: edge sign or verdict at lookback=10 does not match bullish_rsi_divergence's at lookback=5 -- a flip on an arbitrary parameter choice is itself the finding

ideas_declared.rationale: Optional confluence arm: bullish RSI divergence gated by the 200-day trend filter used throughout this study (note pp. 2, 4, 6, 8, 9). Given the prior study's confluence finding (REPORT.md #11 -- stacking reliably shrinks sample, its hit-rate effect does not), this arm is expected to cost sample size predictably and help unpredictably.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: edge does not exceed bullish_rsi_divergence's ungated edge on the same symbol
